content.title: 2026 RBC Heritage: TV schedule, streaming info, how to watch, tee times
content.text: The 2026 RBC Heritage features a star-studded field. Jared C. Tilton/Getty Images The 2026 RBC Heritage gets underway this week at Harbour Town Golf Links on Hilton Head Island, S.C. Here’s everything you need to know to watch the PGA Tour tournament, including a full RBC Heritage TV schedule, streaming information and complete tee times for the first and second rounds once they are released.How to watch RBC HeritageThe Masters is over, and now the action switches back to the PGA Tour with this week’s RBC Heritage.If you thought the RBC field would suffer coming on the heels of the Masters, think again. Although Masters champ Rory McIlroy is not in the field, pretty much every other Tour star from last week is teeing it up at Harbour Town.That includes World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler, who is the betting favorite this week. Joining Scheffler will be Cameron Young, Jordan Spieth, Collin Morikawa, Jason Day and more.This week’s tournament is another PGA Tour Signature Event, featuring a limited field and a $20 million purse, with $3.6 million going to the winner.CBS and Golf Channel will provide TV coverage of the 2026 RBC Heritage, while PGA Tour Live on ESPN+ will offer streaming coverage and featured group coverage all week long. Paramount+ will air simulcasts of CBS’s coverage.You can find complete information about streaming or watching the tournament on TV below.Want to place a wager on the RBC Heritage? Sign up for Fanatics Sportsbook with code “SUBPAR” to receive a special welcome offer.Tournament basicsWhat: 2026 RBC HeritageWhere: Harbour Town Golf Links, Hilton Head Island, S.C.When: Thursday-Sunday, April 16-19Purse: $20 million ($3.6 million winner’s share) Get ESPN+ With an ESPN+ subscription, you gain access to PGA Tour Live, where you can stream the best PGA Tour events live from wherever you want. How to watch on TVCBS and Golf Channel will air TV coverage of the 2026 RBC Heritage this week. Check out the full TV schedule below.Thursday, April 16: 2-6 p.m. ET (Golf Channel)Friday, April 17: 2-6 p.m. ET (Golf Channel)Saturday, April 18: 1-3 p.m. ET (Golf Channel); 3-6 p.m. ET (CBS)Sunday, April 19: 1-3 p.m. ET (Golf Channel); 3-6 p.m. ET (CBS)How to watch online, streamingYou can watch the 2026 RBC Heritage online via PGA Tour Live on ESPN+, including exclusive early coverage starting at 7 a.m. ET Thursday-Sunday. ESPN+ will also provide featured hole and featured group coverage all four days of the tournament.
